STI — Industrial Ethernet
STI-2804F
28-Port Industrial Managed Switch · 4×10G SFP+ · Dual PSU · ERPS
Key Differentiators
Dual PSU — Hot-Swappable
Redundant power input with hot-swap capability. No downtime on power supply failure — critical for 24/7 industrial deployments where maintenance windows are limited.
ERPS G.8032 Ring Protection
Sub-20ms network recovery. Purpose-built for ring topologies in factory floors, substations, and CCTV backbones where packet loss has real operational cost.
-40°C to +75°C Operating Range
Extended temperature tolerance for outdoor cabinets, transportation infrastructure, and harsh industrial environments without additional cooling.
